app.title: NTE Autofish NXXT
firstLaunch.caption: Pick the platform and capture backend once. The fishing controls stay hidden until the capture path is explicit.
platform.wayland.caption: Uses xdg-desktop-portal and PipeWire picker. This is the expected path on your desktop.
platform.x11.caption: Classic window capture. Kept for compatibility, not the current default.
platform.windows.caption: Placeholder for the upstream-style backend. Visible here so the setup model is not Linux-only.
windowPicker.caption: Select the X11/XWayland game window to capture.
runtime.caption: Settings that affect how the UI and capture service start.
resetSetup.body1: This will return the app to first-launch setup. Fishing controls will be hidden until setup is completed again.
resetSetup.body2: Second confirmation: reset platform/backend setup now?
fishingMode.help: EZ keeps the normal flow compact: one Start button, Stable controller and default timings. PRO adds fishing delay tuning and extra reel/debug controls.
fishingTuning.title: Fishing timing
fishingTuning.caption: Only in PRO. Adjust hook F, result screen, recast and watchdog delays.
reelController.help: Stable is the default and has no tuning knobs. Experimental exposes VSH high-stamina reel tuning and can be adjusted without changing the stable controller. Boundary follow and Chizukuo PID remain available for comparison.
experimental.title: Experimental tuning
experimental.caption: Only affects Experimental. Stable stays non-configurable.
experimental.warning.title: Experimental VSH config
experimental.warning.body: This is an experimental VSH config. From release to release it may improve or break.
debugDisabled: Enable Debug messages in Settings to show raw detector telemetry.
chizukuo.title: Chizukuo PID
chizukuo.body: PID we adapted from Chizu's NTE AF. Due to architecture difference, here it might not work that good as with Chizu's Autofish. But it is still so good!! Thanks, Chizu-san
aboutApp.affiliation: We aren't affiliated with Perfect World (Beijing) Software Technology Development Co., Ltd.

settings.capture.caption: Change platform and backend without resetting the whole app. Stop capture before applying.
settings.capture.watchingHint: Stop capture before changing the capture path.
settings.logsHint: Logs are written under logs/ in the app folder when file logging is enabled.
reel.stable.caption: Default PID-style reel control.
reel.boundary.caption: Hold inside the green zone edges.
reel.chizukuo.caption: Chizukuo-style PID pulses.
reel.experimental.caption: VSH guard mode with tunable pulses.
settings.reel.ezHint: EZ offers Stable and Boundary. Switch to PRO for Chizukuo PID and Experimental.
